description: SEC Form 4 transactions by one insider: identity (filer name, CIK, roles seen), the issuers they traded, and their transaction history, filed through 2026-10-22. One of cik or name is required and the call is refused free (400) before payment when neither is given. The free precheck (GET /toll/insiders/precheck?op=insider) returns the exact match count before paying. $0.005 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/insiders/insider.

cik.description: Filer (insider) CIK — provide cik OR name

limit.description: Number of history rows to return

name.description: Insider (filer) name substring, case-insensitive — provide cik OR name
